subject: Pricing tier prune & feature swap for Q3 POC
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@atlasretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T14:02:00-04:00
Subject: Pricing tier prune & feature swap for Q3 POC

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off a small Q3 POC and want to tighten our Monthly Active Seats for the short run while swapping a couple of features. Current plan is 25 seats across two teams; for the POC we want to trim to 10 seats and instead of the realtime-embeddings add the long-context token window (for chat summarization).

Requirements:
- 10 active seats for 90 days
- ~200 requests/min peak, <150ms median token latency target
- Feature swap: remove realtime embeddings (we can delay) and enable long context (+KV cache)

Questions:
1) Can Redwood support a temporary tier/pricing to reflect the seat reduction and feature swap?
2) Is there a one-time credit or promotional price for POCs that would offset switching costs?
3) Any impact on SLA or rollout windows for swapping those features?

Procurement will want a short quote and any paperwork (we'll route to procurement@atlasretail.com). Can you share something by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks —
Elena Park
Head of AI, Atlas Retail
elena@atlasretail.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier prune & feature swap for Q3 POC

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can absolutely support a temporary seat trim + feature swap for the POC. High level options I recommend so you can pick fast:

Option A — Trimmed Tier (short-term)
- Seats: 10 for 90 days
- Feature swap: long-context enabled (same model family)
- Price: prorated monthly seat rate (we'll apply a POC credit)
- Notes: No SLA change for Hosted API; Dedicated would need heads-up for routing policy.

Option B — Short-term Commitment (6-month)
- Seats: 10 committed for 6 months
- 10% volume discount on seat pricing; feature swap included
- Priority onboarding window for feature flags (2-week lead)

I'll have Aditya put numbers behind both options and attach a short quote. If you're comfortable, we can also offer a one-time POC credit to offset first month (we usually reserve this for mid-size pilots).

Next steps:
- Aditya: can you create the proposal PDF with pricing + a recommended route?
- Elena: if procurement has a form, loop it in (procurement@atlasretail.com).

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Mobile: +1-415-555-0124

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-19T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier prune & feature swap for Q3 POC — proposal attached

Elena / Soojin —

Attached is a short proposal (proposal_pricing_20270518.pdf) and a concise pricing table below. This is tuned for a 90-day POC with an option to convert to a 6-month commitment at the same effective rate.

Pricing snapshot (monthly, USD) — 10-seat POC
- Base seat rate (hosted): $450 / seat / month = $4,500
- Long-context feature add-on (flat): $1,200 / month
- POC credit (one-time): -$1,200 applied to first invoice
- Effective first month (prorated + credit): ~$4,500 - $1,200 = $3,300

6-month commit option:
- 10 seats committed x $405 / seat / month (10% off) = $4,050 / month
- Long-context included in the commitment for no extra monthly flat fee for the first 3 months

Special notes:
- We can extend a one-time promotional discount of 8% on the first 3 invoices if Atlas signs a 6-month conversion inside the POC window.
- SLA: Hosted API SLA unchanged; if you need guaranteed tail latency or dedicated capacity we can scope Dedicated with a lead time of ~3 weeks (extra fee).
- Rollout: feature flag flip can happen within 48–72 hours for Hosted API; rollout playbook will be handled by Marissa (CC'd).

Next steps:
1) Elena: confirm preferred option (90-day POC or 6-month commit) and procurement contact.
2) If you want a formal quote/PO-ready doc, I'll produce a DocuSign-ready PDF and include the HubSpot deal link (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5829-AT-0421).

If helpful I can call procurement directly — happy to coordinate.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
Attachment: proposal_pricing_20270518.pdf

Aditya / Soojin —

This looks good and aligned with our expectations. We'll take the 90-day POC with the POC credit and convert to the 6-month commit if performance meets our SLOs. Please prepare a PO-ready quote and send to procurement@atlasretail.com and I'll route to our procurement team.
